name: pxc04m
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)
main IDT @ 0x1000 with #PF/#GP/#UD interrupt gates + lidt
page tables: PT0 identity EXCEPT PT0[5]: linear 0x5000 -> phys 0x601000 (non-contiguous); PT1[0] present, PT1[1] NP (demand-page target); CR3 + CR0.PG 0->1

phase 1 (correctness): IDT2 base 0x4FCE (8-misaligned) puts vector 6's gate at 0x4FFE spanning 0x4FFE-0x5005; the selector/attr/offset-high bytes live on phys 0x601000 (phys 0x5000 poisoned 0x0B0B0B0B); UD2 must deliver to the real ud_handler -> marker 0x2038=0x600DF00D

phase 2 (fault-before-completion): IDT3 base 0x4EFC puts vector 32's gate at 0x4FFC (crossing) while the #PF gate stays in present page 4; page 5 flipped NOT-PRESENT; int $32 -> #PF(CR2=0x5000) before any delivery state moves; handler maps page 5 -> phys 0x601000, IRET restarts the int, delivery reaches int32_handler -> marker 0x203C=0x600DF00D; main IDT restored
pfault flow: demand-page #PF at 0x401000, #GP on selector 0x38, #UD on UD2; counters accumulate to 5

witnesses.edx at exit: 0x004000F4 -- CR2 0x401000 captured by the demand-page #PF, low 16 bits clobbered by the 0xF4 exit-port load
witnesses.edi at exit: 0x600DF00D -- phase 1: the straddling gate delivered to the correct handler (offset/selector/attr assembled from both physical frames)
witnesses.ebx at exit: 0x600DF00D -- phase 2: the int restarted after the NP page was mapped and delivered through the crossing gate

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-C03 regression for producer S_INT_GATE: an IDT gate straddling a page boundary (deliberately misaligned IDT base, since 8-byte gates at aligned bases can never straddle) must be assembled from BOTH physical frames and deliver to the correct handler. Phase 1: non-contiguous frames (page 5 = phys 0x601000, wrong frame poisoned) with a UD2 delivery. Phase 2: page 5 not-present -- the crossing gate read must #PF with CR2=0x5000 before any delivery commits, then complete after the handler maps the page. Differential against QEMU. Built on the pfault skeleton, whose #PF/#GP/#UD deliveries still run and count.
